scientific_question: Does the v148 detector-group Krylov representation retain capacity on all 3700 opened PoolFire cells, and can one shared camera-permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only CPU predictor recover its canonical group coordinates under complete-trajectory leave-one-out?
scope: Post-open development evaluation on five opened PoolFire trajectories. It is not an external test, a physical warm-start replay, a call reduction, a resource result, a curved-ray result, or a real BOST result.

target_blind_state.direction_basis: exact v148 pair-depth basis rebuilt from exact K1 dual, signed K1 residual, and reported geometry
target_blind_state.grouping: reported target-camera slot times two plus detector component
target_blind_state.active_group_policy: use only target-camera/component groups represented by the frozen 96-direction table; require between one and twice the active camera count and never impute a missing group
target_blind_state.canonical_basis: fixed-order two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt over each group's four normalized Krylov columns

deployment_visible_group_features.set_context: concatenate the local vector with active-group mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum of the same local vector

canonical_target.source: the normalized 96-entry v143 K4-minus-K1 Riesz action selected by the frozen v147 direction table
canonical_target.coordinate: inner products with the target-blind fixed-order canonical group basis

outer_evaluation.group_weight: each sample has unit total weight split equally across its active groups

frozen_methods.oracle_block_krylov4: truth-aware canonical projection; capacity upper bound only
frozen_methods.visible_seed_control: v148 signed visible seed; no fitted parameters
frozen_methods.fit_mean_control: four weighted fit-only canonical-coordinate means with inactive degrees masked

rff_set_ridge.lengthscale: fit-only median positive Euclidean distance among the 512 standardized feature rows with lexicographically smallest SHA-256 digests after rounding to 12 decimal places

non_exchangeable_decision_rule: If target-blind state construction, canonicalization, fitting, scoring, or independent recomputation is invalid, return INCONCLUSIVE_GROUP_KRYLOV_PREDICTOR_V149.
If oracle_block_krylov4 fails the full 3700-cell gate, return FAIL_FULL_ROSTER_GROUP_KRYLOV_CAPACITY_V149 and close this representation without using a larger model.
If fit_mean_control passes, return HEADROOM_FIT_MEAN_GROUP_KRYLOV_V149 and prefer it over learned models.
Else if rff_set_ridge passes, return HEADROOM_RFF_GROUP_KRYLOV_PREDICTOR_V149.
Else return FAIL_OBSERVATION_ONLY_GROUP_KRYLOV_PREDICTOR_V149 and close this predictor family.

authorization_after_independent_validati.positive_predictor_result: freeze a separate physical replay with exact A/A^T accounting and matched field/full-gradient/interior-gradient/observation gates
authorization_after_independent_validati.capacity_or_prediction_failure: close the current group-Krylov predictor family; do not rescue it with CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU
